description: Nuron is making his debut with the Stuttgarter Philharmoniker, performing Rachmaninoff’s Piano Concerto No. 3.
Nuron is returning to Kölner Philharmonie to perform Rachmaninoff’s Piano Concerto No. 3.
Nuron is making his third appearance in Kyiv, and will give masterclasses to young Ukrainian music students at the Vere Music Fund.
